always_block.reason: force push rewrites remote history and can destroy someone else's work
git reset --hard discards uncommitted changes irreversibly
git clean removes untracked files that cannot be recovered
--all/--mirror push every branch, including protected ones

always_confirm.reason: rewrites the entire history of every ref
expire/delete reflog destroys the recovery path for lost commits
update-ref moves refs directly, bypassing the normal push and merge paths
pruning or aggressive repack can delete objects still needed by other clones
